HCM: Sarcomeric mutations (*MYH7*, *MYBPC3*) — Storage disorders (Fabry disease, glycogen storage)

qs.q: The genetic defect associated with Fabry's disease is most likely carried on which chromosome?
qs.e: Fabry disease is an X-linked lysosomal storage disorder caused by mutations in the GLA gene, which is located on the X chromosome. This explains its typically X-linked recessive inheritance pattern.
